title: Microsoft Teams External Access & Guest Governance
author_notes: Effort tier: T3 (enterprise Microsoft 365 Teams administration).

MicrosoftTeams PowerShell and the M365 admin center authored at exact detail from Microsoft public docs; plan-/version-dependent behavior (licensing/plan tiers, Premium features, Commercial vs Government cloud URLs like *.office365.us) cited or flagged 'verify in your tenant', never invented. Third-party devices/apps/tools at the pattern level. Automation is PowerShell — no hardcoded credentials or secrets in code. No client names. Compliance/legal determinations (records schedules, legal holds, info-barrier policy) deferred to compliance/legal.
hook: Let people collaborate externally in Teams — safely and on policy
problem: External and guest collaboration in Teams is powerful and risky — ungoverned, it leaks data and accumulates stale guests. This solution governs external access and guests: external access (federation) vs guest access, allow/block domains, guest entitlement and access reviews (Entra), shared channels (B2B direct connect), and sensitivity/expiration — so external collaboration is enabled and controlled.
whats_inside: Solution Overview — external access vs guest access vs shared channels (B2B direct connect), allow/block, guest lifecycle, and sensitivity.
Requirements Guide — prerequisites with how to verify/implement (Teams + Entra External ID, admin roles, cross-tenant access settings, governance stakeholders).

Implementation Guide — configure external/guest/shared-channel settings, set allow/block domains + cross-tenant access, wire guest access reviews + expiration, and apply sensitivity — pilot-first, each policy named.

5 PowerShell scripts — Discovery, Configuration/Remediation, Validation, Reporting, and a scope/health helper — authentic MicrosoftTeams PowerShell / Microsoft Graph automation (read-only or -WhatIf by default; no credentials in code).
Validation gates (external scoped to policy, stale guests reviewed, shared channels controlled) plus Best Practices for safe external collaboration.
short: Govern Teams external access & guests — external/guest/shared-channel settings, allow/block domains, guest access reviews + expiration, and sensitivity — so external collaboration is enabled and controlled. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
short_plain: Govern Teams external access & guests — external/guest/shared-channel settings, allow/block domains, guest access reviews + expiration, and sensitivity — so external collaboration is enabled and controlled.
